summary: The 2D screening label is not_2d_applicable, and Studio did not run (simulation status: skipped). The gate blocked the run for three reasons. The custom 2D steady experiment has an empty floorplan and no power_w, so it fails the 1-128 block requirement. The paper supplies no numeric block geometry, per-block power, die area, or HotSpot 7.0 package parameters. The extracted evidence also lacks valid page or pinned-asset locators. The scenario is the Cool-3D baseline: a 3-layer 3DIC (cores under two memory layers) with a passive heat sink, running Splash2 fft in a steady-state HotSpot 7.0 solve. The paper's printed layer maxima are 395.52 K (core), 392.83 K (middle memory) and 390.57 K (top memory). Because Studio produced no result, there is no Studio temperature to compare, so comparison_valid is false. No numerical comparison or replication claim is made. Qualitatively, the paper shows the core layer hottest, and the core0 instruction ratio of 5.87x suggests a concentrated hotspot. This is only a reported observation from the paper, not something verified here. This is a custom steady run, so there is no transient trace, and the paper's baseline has no transient, controller, or optimizer component. The final verdict is no simulation and no valid comparison.
limitations: Studio was not run because the gate requires 1-128 blocks and a power_w object; the extracted floorplan and power are empty.
No Studio temperature exists, so no numerical comparison with 395.52, 392.83 or 390.57 K is made; comparison_valid is false.
Essential mismatch: no numeric floorplan geometry or die area is published; only a labelled, dimensionless heat-map layout in Fig. 9.
Essential mismatch: no per-block or total power for the fft baseline is published; McPAT and CACTI-3DD outputs are not tabulated.
Essential mismatch: the 3-layer vertical stack with layer-to-layer coupling cannot be represented by a 2D or single-die Studio model.
Essential mismatch: passive heat-sink, spreader, TIM, material, ambient and grid parameters for HotSpot 7.0 are not published; any Studio values would be bundled defaults.
The paper values are layer-wise maxima from a 3D steady-state HotSpot 7.0 solve. They are not the same location, aggregation or boundary assumptions as any 2D Studio output would be.
Evidence items lack valid page or pinned-asset locators, and independent page/asset review and the adversarial checks are unresolved.

The Cool-3D GitHub repository is not pinned or bundled and is described as being in the process of release, so the existence of its inputs is unverified. The Splash2 repository holds benchmark source, not thermal inputs.
Upstream gem5, McPAT and CACTI-3DD power generation cannot be reproduced, and no exact replication of the paper's result is claimed.
This is a custom 2D steady scenario with no transient trace, and no bundled EV6/GCC adapted demonstration was used.
A custom experiment needs 1–128 blocks and a power_w object
